verdict.rationale: Jan is open source and its GitHub README describes a one-command build flow that 'installs dependencies, builds core components, and launches the app', so building from source is supported. Nothing shows the build has minimal external dependencies; the script fetches dependencies automatically, and the runtime is powered by llama.cpp. Missing for 10: evidence of a minimal or documented dependency footprint, detailed build prerequisites and steps, independent or hands-on reports of building from source.
